## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 337 captures during January 2019. This represents the site’s reported activity for the month. The capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and subsequent grading performance. Activity was recorded for the clinic as a whole, with the results considered alongside the number of images that could not be graded and the number assessed as referable.

## Image quality

Of the 337 captures, 21 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 6.2 per cent. These images could not proceed through the usual grading process, and the rate is reported to support ongoing monitoring of image quality at West Gate Eye Clinic. The result should be considered with the overall capture activity for January 2019.

## Grading

There were 49 referable results during the month. The median lag between capture and grading was 10 days. Together, these measures summarise grading outcomes and timeliness for January 2019. The findings provide a concise view of the service delivered at West Gate Eye Clinic, including the volume of activity, the proportion of images unavailable for grading, referable results, and the time taken for grading.
